import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import * as mod from '../../src/resolvers/template-input-lint-scan';

describe('genuine', () => {
  test('flags the unused input', async () => {
    const result = await mod.resolveTemplateInputLintScan({
      type: 'template_input_lint_scan',
      dry_run: true,
      _templates: [{ id: 'x', inputShapes: ['gapScenario'], tasks: [{ inputShapes: ['gapScenario'] }] }],
    });
    expect(result.shape).toBe('templateInputLintReport');
    expect(result.body.finding_count).toBe(1);
  });
});
